regions.merged_text: DEATH. Card'1 Wiseman's meeting of ... going home for vacation ... But, 0 the Death of St. Francis! ... . What a scene of Jubilation! As having passed his day's crucifixion and immune from further pain he inspires his brethren and, in joyful psalms and hymns joins them as with him they welcome God's own gentle representative, none other for him now than Sister Death. Deo gratias.
